subject: Indigenous voices on the cost of commodified plant medicine
script: From Agewell Brief: Indigenous voices on the cost of commodified plant medicine. Indigenous voices highlight the commodification of sacred plant medicine in the Amazon. Ayahuasca marketed as shortcut to healing and enlightenment. Indigenous storyteller Nina Gualinga calls it commodification and extractivism. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
